candidate_practices.name: Make the measurement correction the contribution
candidate_practices.source_observation: These abstracts identify what existing evaluations omit and introduce a corresponding comparison, split, metric, or benchmark.
candidate_practices.why_it_may_help: Interpretation: this explains why changing evaluation can advance understanding without proposing a stronger predictor.
candidate_practices.application: Replace an undifferentiated benchmark complaint with the omitted variable, its consequence, and the evaluation change that addresses it.
candidate_practices.when_not_to_use: When the proposed correction changes the intended evaluation question or cannot represent its target conditions.

support.specific_example: Unequal task exposure motivates matched task-relevant fine-tuning.
Similarity-skewed splits motivate distribution-adaptive splitting and distribution-fit assessment.
Static deterministic comparisons motivate a distance between noisy trajectories.
BigCodeBench supplies multi-library tasks, coverage diagnostics, and an instruction variant as contributions.

contrasts.contrast: LaMPlace retains downstream chip metrics but learns a cheap evaluator; evaluation cost can require approximation rather than a new benchmark.

candidate_practices.full_text_needed_for: Whether corrections realize their intended comparison and whether benchmark coverage supports capability claims.

candidate_practices.name: Make the diagnosis select the intervention
candidate_practices.source_observation: These abstracts connect a named failure mechanism to a specific technical change.
candidate_practices.why_it_may_help: Interpretation: this turns novelty into an inspectable change in explanation and design.
candidate_practices.application: Write separate sentences for the observed failure, proposed explanation, and intervention acting on that explanation.
candidate_practices.when_not_to_use: When the mechanism is conjectural, retain that status instead of presenting intervention success as causal identification.

support.specific_example: Kernel performance differences lead to an initialization-based gradient-vanishing explanation and repair.
Function-activation bias motivates function-vector stabilization.
Dimensional collapse motivates decorrelated selection and more uniform covariance eigenvalues.
Reconstruction-induced value discrepancies motivate invertible latent mappings.

contrasts.contrast: TopoLM uses spatial smoothness to model cortical organization; resemblance supports a possible explanation without identifying a unique biological cause.

candidate_practices.full_text_needed_for: Evidence distinguishing explanations, intervention specificity, and residual failure modes.

candidate_practices.name: Describe interfaces instead of listing modules
candidate_practices.source_observation: These abstracts assign distinct inputs and operations to interacting components.
candidate_practices.why_it_may_help: Interpretation: interfaces explain why multiple contributions belong together.
candidate_practices.application: Rewrite a component list as an information path: input, transformation, output, and next consumer.
candidate_practices.when_not_to_use: When components are implementation details with no meaningful division of responsibility.

support.specific_example: LLM equation skeletons feed evolutionary search and parameter fitting.
Patient subtype representations and prior-network representations meet through an integration loss.
LLM abductions inform a Bayesian network used for deduction.
Graph diffusion organizes demonstrations, observations, and actions; simulated pseudo-demonstrations supply training.

contrasts.contrast: A linear-mapping finding precedes the ID-free recommender; a representation discovery can lead before architecture.

candidate_practices.full_text_needed_for: Interface details, component dependencies, and whether each component contributes independently.

candidate_practices.name: Attach guarantees to the regime that changes them
candidate_practices.source_observation: These abstracts separate outcomes by supervision, sparsity, parameter ordering, or algorithmic variant.
candidate_practices.why_it_may_help: Interpretation: this makes the meaning of efficiency or optimality conditional and comparable.
candidate_practices.application: Place the assumption before each rate and state the comparator class and remaining factors.
candidate_practices.when_not_to_use: When no comparable rates exist; describe the supported scope without inventing quantitative guarantees.

support.specific_example: Unsupervised intermediate steps, teacher forcing, and augmented verification receive different learning claims.
Dense and sparse learning rates are compared with SQ bounds up to polylogarithmic factors.
Two smoothness–convexity orderings receive separate lower bounds and upper-bound comparisons.
Sample and communication complexities change when variance reduction is added.

contrasts.contrast: The abstract states deterministic dynamics and null-space noise without numerical complexity bounds.
A perturbative initialization regime supports structural characterization rather than an efficiency comparison.

candidate_practices.full_text_needed_for: Oracle conventions, theorem assumptions, matching regimes, and proof details.

candidate_practices.name: Separate the construct from its operational measure
candidate_practices.source_observation: These abstracts introduce measures or proxies before reporting relationships or applications.
candidate_practices.why_it_may_help: Interpretation: naming the computation helps prevent a broad construct from silently becoming equivalent to one score.
candidate_practices.application: State what is measured, what it stands for, and which subsequent claims concern the measure specifically.
candidate_practices.when_not_to_use: When the proxy has no defensible connection to the target; downstream usefulness alone does not establish construct validity.

support.specific_example: A variant of the generation-verification gap is linked to pretraining FLOPs.
Web-snippet reconstruction underlies CREATIVITY INDEX and a separate detection application.
Generation-probability proxies define attribution targets assessed through LDS and retraining.
Memory-source breadth is associated with acquisition and retention, followed by an activity intervention.

contrasts.contrast: OCM targets an analytic covariance quantity, then reports approximation error and downstream metrics.
AERCA operationalizes anomalies through exogenous interventions; this is a modeling assumption, not merely a score.

candidate_practices.full_text_needed_for: Definitions, measurement validity, proxy sensitivity, and causal interpretation.

candidate_practices.name: Give each evidence setting a distinct inferential role
candidate_practices.source_observation: These abstracts distinguish controlled simulations, benchmark settings, biological data, or model-based possibilities.
candidate_practices.why_it_may_help: Interpretation: readers can distinguish recovery under known conditions from correspondence beyond those conditions.
candidate_practices.application: Replace a dataset inventory with what each setting tests and the inference it permits.
candidate_practices.when_not_to_use: When settings do not support different inferences; do not manufacture an evidence hierarchy.

support.specific_example: Known simulated manifolds precede functional clustering in macaque V1.
Assumption-matched simulations, DisLib factors, and ImageNet proxy decoding remain distinct.
Synthetic networks, Gaussian mixtures, and blood-development snapshots support different demonstrations.
Simulated dimensionality is assessed through colorimetry; human enhancement remains a possibility.

contrasts.contrast: Large-model benefits are scaling-law extrapolations, not direct experiments at the projected scale.
Linear convergence, nonlinear feedback, and application tests concern different method stages.

candidate_practices.full_text_needed_for: Ground truth, proxy construction, assumptions, and transfer between evidence settings.

candidate_practices.name: Report the gain beside the capability at risk
candidate_practices.source_observation: These abstracts report outcomes that expose more than one success criterion.
candidate_practices.why_it_may_help: Interpretation: paired criteria make the intended improvement more decision-relevant than a single aggregate gain.
candidate_practices.application: Name both objectives and report their outcomes within clearly identified settings.
candidate_practices.when_not_to_use: When measurements come from incomparable conditions or do not measure the claimed retained capability.

support.specific_example: TokenCourt and a judge module accompany speed, quality, and hardware-specific throughput reports.
Reduced reproduction is paired with generation quality and extraction robustness.
A transport trade-off accompanies docking performance and favorable-pose proportions of 30% to 73%.
In-domain results accompany out-of-domain changes, including prior-method declines.

contrasts.contrast: CCA moves control into training, so sampling savings and fine-tuning cost remain distinct.
Style fidelity and prompt adherence are stated qualitatively; training-free still includes test-time optimization.

candidate_practices.full_text_needed_for: Joint trade-offs, cost accounting, comparator conditions, and unreported degradations.

unusual_but_useful.practice: Lead with a neuronal alternative without inventing a prior-work gap.
unusual_but_useful.application: Connect synchronization to the representation hypothesis.
unusual_but_useful.limit: Broad task gains do not establish that hypothesis.

unusual_but_useful.practice: Separate paradigm, implementation, and generalization conditions.
unusual_but_useful.application: Distinguish PIDM from Seer and name tested shifts.
Separate benchmark comparisons from exploratory explanations.
unusual_but_useful.limit: Component importance is not established here.

unusual_but_useful.application: State how under-8% aligned pairs enter guidance.
unusual_but_useful.limit: This is not a proven minimum requirement.

unusual_but_useful.application: Explain why Hessian reuse changes total cost.

unusual_but_useful.practice: Connect attribution to localized intervention and related-model overlap.
unusual_but_useful.application: Report both behavioral effects and recurrence.
Contrast weighted similarities with concatenation similarity.

unusual_but_useful.practice: Describe synthetic data by the missing knowledge it supplies.
unusual_but_useful.application: Connect cross-client class and structure information to local shifts.

unusual_but_useful.practice: State the mathematical object enabled by an extension.
unusual_but_useful.application: Connect uncontrasted features to categorical polytopes and hierarchy.

discarded_generalizations.reason: These abstracts cannot exclude competing explanations.
